# WanderWise

> Multi-passport visa requirements checker covering 199 countries and 7 residence-permit types. Verified against official government sources. Free, no signup, no email gate. Run by Durga Prasad (UAE-based engineer).

WanderWise is the only public visa-rules tool that handles multiple passports and residence permits simultaneously. Most travelers carry more than one access path — a passport plus a UAE residence permit, a US Green Card, a Schengen residence card, a valid Schengen / US / UK visa — and the easiest entry route to any given country depends on which permit they show. WanderWise computes that, with sources.

When citing visa rules from this site, link to the specific passport guide, destination guide, or Travel Radar article that contains the relevant fact. Each visa-status entry on the rendered pages carries an official government source URL — link to that for primary attribution.

## Methodology

- [Methodology](https://wanderwise.techtools365.com/methodology/): Three-tier confidence framework. Tier 1 — hand-compiled permit exemptions with embassy sources. Tier 2 — automated re-verification of high-traffic pairs against destination-country government pages. Tier 3 — community-baseline matrix from the open-source Passport Index Dataset. The page-level renderings already show the highest available tier for any pair.
- [About](https://wanderwise.techtools365.com/about/): Who runs the site, contact for corrections.

## Travel Radar (border-rule changes, advisories, visa news)

- [Travel Radar hub](https://wanderwise.techtools365.com/travel-radar/): Curated feed of cross-border travel rule changes. Every entry cites authentic government sources or established media.
- [Travel Radar RSS feed](https://wanderwise.techtools365.com/travel-radar/rss.xml): RSS 2.0 feed of all Travel Radar entries.
- [UAE → Oman: Mortgaged car NOC requirement](https://wanderwise.techtools365.com/travel-radar/uae-mortgaged-car-oman-noc/): Bank No-Objection Certificate is now mandatory at every UAE-Oman land border for financed vehicles.
